name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms governing how both parties may use and must protect Confidential Information shared for a stated Purpose.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the Purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality period, governing law, jurisdiction and signatures; incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper SLA used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement, defining target uptime, uptime calculation, target response times, support, and service credits.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper DPA setting out processor and subprocessor obligations for processing customer personal data, including security, subprocessors, data subject requests, breach notification and international transfers.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard terms for giving a design partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services and deliverables under one or more Statements of Work (SOWs).

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard terms for a business partnership in which each party performs agreed obligations, covering cooperation, fees, trademark use, confidentiality and liability.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper BAA establishing HIPAA obligations for a provider (business associate) that uses or discloses protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard terms for licensing software that the customer installs and runs on its own systems, covering license grant, restrictions, fees, warranties, liability and termination.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper short-term trial/evaluation agreement letting a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement such as a CSA or Software License Agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper addendum supplementing a commercial agreement with terms for AI services, covering use of Input and Output, model training restrictions and related obligations.
